functions.name: dist
functions.done: Euclidean, Manhattan, Canberra, supremum, Bray, and Minkowski with p = 3.

proof.r:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(proxy))
if (packageDescription("proxy")$Version != "0.4-29") stop("expected proxy 0.4-29")
json_num <- function(x) paste0("[", paste(sprintf("%.17g", as.numeric(x)), collapse=","), "]")

one <- function() {
  x <- matrix(c(1,2, 3,6, 4,8, 7,1), ncol=2, byrow=TRUE)
  c(as.numeric(dist(x)), as.numeric(dist(x, method="Manhattan")),
    as.numeric(dist(x, method="Canberra")), as.numeric(dist(x, method="supremum")),
    as.numeric(dist(x, method="Bray")), as.numeric(dist(x, method="Minkowski", p=3)))
}
value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat(sprintf('{"value":%s,"median_ms":%.17g}\n', json_num(value), median(elapsed) * 1000))
proof.python:
import json
import statistics
import sys
import time

sys.path[:0] = ["/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/proxy"]
from proxy.dist import (
    as_dist, as_matrix, as_simil, col_dist, colMeans_dist, colSums_dist,
    dist, pr_DB, pr_dist2simil, pr_simil2dist, row_dist, rowMeans_dist,
    rowSums_dist, simil,
)

def one():
    x = [[1, 2], [3, 6], [4, 8], [7, 1]]
    return (list(dist(x)) + list(dist(x, method="Manhattan"))
            + list(dist(x, method="Canberra")) + list(dist(x, method="supremum"))
            + list(dist(x, method="Bray")) + list(dist(x, method="Minkowski", p=3)))
value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
print(json.dumps({"value": value, "median_ms": statistics.median(elapsed)}))

import json
import statistics
import sys
import time

sys.path[:0] = ["/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/proxy"]
from proxy.dist import (
    as_dist, as_matrix, as_simil, col_dist, colMeans_dist, colSums_dist,
    dist, pr_DB, pr_dist2simil, pr_simil2dist, row_dist, rowMeans_dist,
    rowSums_dist, simil,
)

def one():
    names = pr_DB.get_entry_names()
    if len(names) != 50:
        raise SystemExit("expected 50 entries")
    return [int(flag) for flag in pr_DB.get_field_entries("distance")]
value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
print(json.dumps({"value": value, "median_ms": statistics.median(elapsed)}))
